name: scummvm-sci
title: ScummVM SCI
description: Classic Sierra SCI adventure games. Add your own game data; game files are not included.
author: ScummVM Team; PAX port by RetroESP32-P4
about: Classic Sierra SCI adventure games. Runs as a standalone ScummVM engine build on ESP32-P4. Copy each game into its own folder under /sd/roms/scummvm, then choose Add Game. The store provides matching ScummVM runtime resources; commercial game data is not bundled.
changelog: 2026.3.0: PAX engine build with ScummVM game detection, controller and keyboard input, touch/mouse, and persistent ScummVM game saves.
controls: USB keyboard: full ScummVM key input
Save/load: use the game’s own ScummVM save menu
